title: Orders of magnitude and scientific notation

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to talk to you about scientific notation.
cues.zh: 這段要談科學記號。

cues.en: I will introduce the concept and explain why scientific notation is important.
cues.zh: 介紹概念，並解釋它為什麼重要。

cues.en: And you'll also get to see how to print and decode scientific notation in Python.
cues.zh: 也會看到，如何在 Python 印出、解讀科學記號。

cues.en: This will also help you better understand how to print information in Python in strings.
cues.zh: 這也會幫助理解，如何用 Python 字串印出資訊。

cues.en: Now, I've already introduced this concept of scientific notation several times in this course.
cues.zh: 這門課已經介紹過科學記號好幾次。

cues.en: In particular, it was related to discussions of numbers that you expected to be zero, but they ended up being some weird looking number that was like some a bunch of numbers.
cues.zh: 尤其是，討論某些預期是 0 的數字，結果卻出現奇怪的數字，一串數字，

cues.en: And then there was an E minus 15 after that or something.
cues.zh: 後面接 e-15 之類的內容。

cues.en: So if that still seems confusing, then now is the opportunity to shed some light on that bizarre looking number with the E and the and the minus 15.
cues.zh: 如果仍覺得困惑，現在就來釐清，這種有 e、負 15 的奇怪數字。

cues.en: OK, so here is where we kind of start from scientific notation.
cues.zh: 科學記號的起點，

cues.en: It starts from orders of magnitude.
cues.zh: 是數量級。

cues.en: And the idea of orders of magnitude is to just give us an approximation of the size of a number so we
cues.zh: 數量級的想法，是近似表達一個數字的大小，所以，

cues.en: can say ten thousand and twenty one is sort of kind of equal to ten thousand.
It's not exactly ten thousand, but this number is pretty close to ten thousand.
cues.zh: 不精確等於 10000，但很接近。

cues.en: Now this number is pretty close to one thousand.
cues.zh: 這個數字則接近 1000。

cues.en: It's certainly closer to one thousand than it is to ten thousand.
And this number zero point zero three four is kind of close enough to zero point zero one.
cues.zh: 0.034，某種程度上也夠接近 0.01。

cues.en: So we call these orders of magnitude.
cues.zh: 這些就叫數量級。

cues.en: And the way to convert a number into an order of magnitude is to think about what is the closest power of ten to that number.
cues.zh: 把數字轉成數量級的方法，是想想最接近它的 10 的次方是多少。

cues.en: So, for example, ten to the power of minus two is zero point zero one.
Ten to the zero is one.
cues.zh: 10 的零次方是 1。

cues.en: Ten to the three is one thousand.
cues.zh: 10 的三次方是 1000。

cues.en: And essentially what you're doing with this number in the exponent is using it to shift the decimal point to the left if it's a negative number or to the right if it's a positive number.
cues.zh: 基本上，指數裡這個數字，用來移動小數點；負數往左，正數往右。

cues.en: So ten to the zero means that the decimal point is just after the one.
cues.zh: 10 的零次方，代表小數點就在 1 後面。

cues.en: Ten to the minus one means you take the decimal point that used to be here and you move it over one position to the left and here it's over, two to the left and so on.
cues.zh: 10 的 -1 次方，代表把原本這裡的小數點，往左移一位，這裡則往左兩位，依此類推。

cues.en: So therefore you can say that the number ten thousand and twenty one is four orders of magnitude.
cues.zh: 所以可以說，10021 的數量級是 4。

cues.en: And you say that this is four orders of magnitude because ten thousand and twenty one is pretty close to the number.
cues.zh: 說它是 4，因為 10021 很接近，

cues.en: Ten thousand and 10000 is the same thing as ten to the four.
So four orders of magnitude.
cues.zh: 所以數量級是 4。

cues.en: This will be minus one order of magnitude and so on.
cues.zh: 這個的數量級則是 -1，依此類推。

cues.en: OK, so that's about orders of magnitude and approximations.
cues.zh: 這是數量級和近似。

cues.en: How does scientific notation come into this?
cues.zh: 和科學記號有什麼關係？

cues.en: Well, scientific notation is basically just a shorthand for writing out all of this.
cues.zh: 科學記號，基本上就是把這些東西簡寫。

cues.en: So instead of writing this out in words, you just write it out in numbers so we can say that this number
cues.zh: 不必用文字描述，直接用數字寫，就能說這個數字，

cues.en: ten thousand twenty one is approximately or it's the order of magnitude one times ten to the power of four.
cues.zh: 10021，大約是，或數量級是 1 乘 10 的四次方。

cues.en: And here you would say that two thousand one hundred and nineteen is two times ten to the three, I should say is approximately equal to it's the same order of magnitude as ten to the three.
cues.zh: 這裡，2119 是 2 乘 10 的三次方，應該說大約等於，和 10 的三次方屬於相同數量級。

cues.en: And then to get a little bit more precise, you can say that it's two times ten to the three.
cues.zh: 再精確一點，可以說是 2 乘 10 的三次方。

cues.en: And if you want to get even more precise, you could say that this is two point one times ten to the three.
cues.zh: 想更精確，可以說是 2.1 乘 10 的三次方。

cues.en: And then here for a number that's less than one.
cues.zh: 這裡則是小於 1 的數字。

cues.en: Then you could say that this number is that in scientific notation, this is three times ten to the minus two.
cues.zh: 用科學記號，可以寫成 3 乘 10 的 -2 次方。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is how you would write out scientific notation, like in a math textbook, or if you're writing this out on a chalkboard or on a piece of paper in computers, it looks slightly differently.
cues.zh: 數學教科書、黑板或紙上，會這樣寫科學記號；電腦上稍有不同。

cues.en: And they write E plus or minus and then the number in the exponent.
cues.zh: 會寫 e，再加正負號，以及指數裡的數字。

cues.en: So this is the math notation and this would be the computer notation.
cues.zh: 這是數學寫法，這是電腦寫法。

cues.en: So this is what you see in Python.
cues.zh: Python 會看到這個。

cues.en: So I hope that now it's clear when you see this number in Python and I said that it's a tiny, tiny number.
cues.zh: 希望現在清楚了，為什麼在 Python 看到這個數字，我會說它非常小。

cues.en: It's basically zero plus computer rounding error.
cues.zh: 基本上是 0 加電腦捨入誤差。

cues.en: Then you saw that that was like some number times E minus sixteen.
cues.zh: 當時看到某個數字，後面接 e-16。

cues.en: So that means that there is a decimal point and then 16 zeros and then you get some numbers.
cues.zh: 代表小數點，後面 16 個 0，再有一些數字。

cues.en: Those are tiny numbers.
cues.zh: 都是很小的數字。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's switch to Python and I'm going to introduce you to some alternate ways of printing with special formatting that I haven't yet shown you in this course.
cues.zh: 現在切到 Python，介紹幾種課程還沒教過的特殊格式輸出方法。

cues.en: OK, so let's start with some number.
cues.zh: 先從一個數字開始。

cues.en: And I just want this to be a big number, let's say just like that.
cues.zh: 只要它很大，例如這樣。

cues.en: OK, now what I'm going to write is going to look a little bit strange at first, but this is the way to get this number to print out in scientific notation in Python.
cues.zh: 接下來的寫法，一開始有點奇怪，但這是在 Python 把數字印成科學記號的方法。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do.
cues.zh: 我要做的是，

cues.en: Is print in curly brackets, colon, comma, e, surrounded by single quotes and then dot format and
cues.zh: 在單引號裡寫大括號、冒號、逗號、e，再呼叫 format，

cues.en: then into the format function goes this variable X and let's see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 把變數 x 傳入 format，看看結果。

cues.en: This prints out the first number and then a decimal point and then a couple of other numbers, six other numbers times.
cues.zh: 它印出第一個數字、小數點，再接其他數字，另外六位，乘上，

cues.en: Well, you don't see the times here explicitly, but times E plus nine.
cues.zh: 雖然沒明寫乘號，但乘上 e+9 所表示的倍數。

cues.en: So that means that this number here is three point nine times ten to the nine.
cues.zh: 意思是，這個數字等於 3.9 乘 10 的九次方。

cues.en: And that should make sense, because if we think about the decimal point being here, then we can shift the decimal point over one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine.
cues.zh: 應該合理，因為假設小數點在這裡，就可以移動一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九位。

cues.en: So then that gives us three point nine times ten to the power of nine.
cues.zh: 就得到 3.9 乘 10 的九次方。

cues.en: OK, so let me get rid of this, because that's not proper code there.
cues.zh: 把這個去掉，因為這不是正確程式碼。

cues.en: OK, so this E here is for scientific notation.
cues.zh: 這裡的 e，是科學記號格式。

cues.en: There's also other ways that you can use this general approach to formatting in Python.
cues.zh: 這種 Python 格式設定方式，也能做別的。

cues.en: So, for example, you can try this with D, and that's going to print out this number with commas.
cues.zh: 例如改成 d，就會用逗號印出這個數字。

cues.en: And for most humans, it's a bit easier to read with commas than it is to read without the commas.
cues.zh: 對大部分人，有逗號比沒有容易閱讀。

cues.en: OK, so this is one way to print out in scientific notation.
cues.zh: 這是一種科學記號輸出方式。

cues.en: There's another way which is actually a bit similar to this percent.
cues.zh: 另一種有點像之前教過的百分號，

cues.zh: 就會把這個位置換成字串，印出數字。

cues.zh: 現在做一點變化。

cues.zh: 把 s 改成 e，就會用科學記號印出，像這裡。

cues.en: And now I'm going to do something that I haven't yet introduced you to.
cues.zh: 接著做一件還沒教過的事。

cues.en: I'm going to write point two, so decimal point and then two before the E and what that is going to
cues.zh: 寫 .2，小數點，再 2，放在 e 前面，會，

cues.en: do is specify that this number should print out with two numbers after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 指定小數點後印出兩位。

cues.en: So two degrees of precision after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 也就是小數點後兩位精確度。

cues.en: And if I would put four here, then you guessed it, we are going to get four numbers after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 若這裡放 4，猜對了，小數點後會有四位數字。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now I would like to show you one more thing, and that's it.
cues.zh: 還想示範一件事，

cues.en: You can set this expression here to be a variable.
cues.zh: 可以把這個式子指定給變數。

cues.en: So I can say X equals this thing.
cues.zh: 寫變數等於這個。

cues.en: And now if I print as well, that just gives me back this.
cues.zh: 現在印出它，就會得到這個。

cues.en: But if I print the type of X, then we see that X is a string.
cues.zh: 但若印出它的 type，就會看到是字串。

cues.zh: 這很有意思，代表可以任意索引、切片。

cues.en: So for example, the first element or the zero index into S is going to be three.
cues.zh: 例如 s 的第一個元素，也就是索引 0，是 3。

cues.zh: 這是完整的 s，這是 s 的索引 0，也能例如取出最後兩個數字。

cues.en: We could do that by writing minus to remember from indexing and slicing that minus to the minus two
cues.zh: 寫 -2。記得索引、切片，-2，

cues.en: if index gives you the second to last index and then we.
cues.zh: 這個索引，會得到倒數第二個元素。

cues.en: And then if you want to go from there to the end, you can write minus two colon and that will get you from the second to last element all the way up until the end.
cues.zh: 想從那裡取到最後，就用 -2:，從倒數第二個元素一路到結尾。

cues.en: So that's pretty convenient because now we've just discovered a way to figure out the number corresponding to the order of magnitude.
cues.zh: 很方便，因為剛找到方法，取出對應數量級的數字。

cues.en: And that is the great Segway into the exercise for this video.
cues.zh: 正好銜接這段練習。

cues.en: So what you want to do in this exercise is print the nearest order of magnitude for a given number.
cues.zh: 這次要對給定數字，印出最接近的數量級。

cues.en: So in other words, you want to type in some number, let's say in this case, I picked two thousand three hundred and forty two.
cues.zh: 也就是輸入一個數字，例如這裡選 2342。

cues.zh: 但這個程序應該適用任何數字，正數、負數，或有小數點的數字。
